title: The unended-check closure line advises 'run it again' for a still-running non-carried Codex test whose rerun will be overlapped
outcome: When engram_close_unended_checks closes a Codex test with outcome Unknown that is still recorded as running (EngramSessionState::running_codex_tests) because it could not be carried (it was overlapped, ran in a delegated session, or had no named root), the holder line says it is still running and that a rerun in its worktree is overlapped until it ends or the session is stopped, instead of 'run it again to record it'.
acceptance: A test closes a non-carried still-running Codex test at its turn's close and shows the still-running wording, and a test whose process has ended keeps the existing wording.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
